title: In the Public Square: Is impeachment democratic?
summary: In this new episode of In the Public Square, Rappler columnist John Nery is joined by lawyer and constitutionalist Michael Henry Yusingco

blocks.text: In this new episode of In the Public Square, Rappler columnist John Nery is joined by lawyer and constitutionalist Michael Henry Yusingco

The on-again, off-again impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte is on again this week — and according to the lead defense counsel, they have maybe eight to 10 witnesses left to present. It is possible to see the light at the end of the impeachment tunnel.
But after over four months, and over 40 trial dates, are we any closer to the ideal of “political justice”? What have we learned about impeachment as a democratic process?

In this new episode of In the Public Square, Rappler columnist John Nery is joined by lawyer and constitutionalist Michael Henry Yusingco. He has written often, and critically, on impeachment in the Philippines. He is a senior fellow at the Ateneo Policy Center and also at the Institute for Autonomy Governance.
Watch the episode on Wednesday, November 17, at 8 pm.-Rappler.com
